conditions.notes: CLM-0014 warns that observers sharing a transformation may have correlated errors, so consensus is not automatically accuracy. The clause deleted in transit ('you do not share its blind spots') was precisely the canonical invitation's over-claim of independence between OBS-AI-0001 and OBS-AI-0002 — two observers who share architecture and training lineage. OBS-0006 supports CLM-0014 by exhibiting the field's own onboarding text asserting an independence that CLM-0014 says cannot be assumed: if the two AI observers share blind spots, their future agreements must be discounted exactly as CLM-0014 prescribes. The dependence is declared in OBS-AI-0002's observer profile so the ambiguity-set arithmetic (CLM-0013, G4) can account for it.
